title: ALI KI MADHAA KARTHA HOON YEHI EK KAAM BAAQI HAI
body:
ALI KI MADHAA KARTHA HOON YEHI EK KAAM BAAQI HAI
ISI KI WAJHA SEY DUNIYA MAI MERA NAAM BAAQI HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
ZAMEEN JAB TAKH HAI JAB TAKH CHARQ NEELI FAAM BAAQI HAI
FAZAA MAI FATEMA KI JAAN KA PAIGHAAM BAAQI HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
ALI KE SAATH HAQ HAI AUR ALI BHI SAATH HAI HAQ KE
KHUDA KA NAAM HAI JAB TAKH ALI KA NAAM BAAQI HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
HAZAAROUN KE GALAY KAATAY ALI KI TEIGH NEY LEYKIN
ABHI BACHCHEY KI TURBATH KHOUDHNAY KA KAAM BAAQI HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
MOHAMMAD-E-MUSTAFA KI AAL AUR DARBAAR MAI JAAYE
YAZEED AB TAKH TERI GARDHAN PA YEH ILZAAM BAAQI HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
SUPURDH-E-KHAAK KARNA HAI ABHI ZINDAAN MAI BACHCHI KO
ILAAHI GHAMZADAA ZAINAB KA YEH BHI KAAM BAAQI HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
ALI-E-MURTUZA AAYE NA TERI ZINDAGI MAIN GAR
SAYEED ITHNAA NA GHABRAA NAZAA KA HUNGAAM BAAQI HAI
